caption: The drawing depicts an iron window grille with vertical bars and decorative scrollwork. The grille is composed of two horizontal sections, each with evenly spaced vertical bars. Along both the top and bottom horizontal bars, there are symmetrical spiral designs at regular intervals, as well as on the sides and in the center. The overall shape of the grille is rectangular with slightly bowed top and bottom bars. The iron bars are dark brown in color, with areas shaded to indicate thickness and shadow. Surrounding the grille is a roughly sketched stone window opening, illustrated with gray and light brown shading to suggest texture and depth of the masonry wall behind the grille. The background is plain, off-white.
title: Iron Grille at Window (a Restoration)
